strings.l2_lesson1_step1_body: When you ADD, push MORE beads UP toward the beam. Start at 2, add 1 → push 1 more bead up = 3! More beads = bigger number!
strings.l2_lesson1_step2_body: Push 2 earth beads up to the beam. Your abacus shows 2. This is your starting number!
strings.l2_lesson1_step3_body: Watch the bead move! Start at 2, push 1 more earth bead UP → 3! 🎊
strings.l2_lesson1_step4_body: Start at 2, add 3 more beads. At 5 you swap to the heaven bead! ✨
strings.l2_lesson1_step5_body: Remember: adding always means pushing MORE beads toward the beam. Your number goes UP! Try: 1 + 3 = ? (push 3 more beads!)
strings.l2_lesson2_step1_body: When your total reaches 5 or more, swap 5 earth beads for the HEAVEN bead! Push all earth DOWN + heaven DOWN = 5!
strings.l2_lesson2_step2_body: Watch! Start at 4, add 2 → swap to heaven bead + 1 earth = 6! ✨
strings.l2_lesson2_step3_body: Watch! Start at 3, add 4 → swap to heaven + 2 earth = 7! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson2_step4_body: Watch! Start at 5 (heaven), add 3 earth beads up → heaven + 3 earth = 8! 🎈
strings.l2_lesson2_step5_body: Watch! Start at 5 (heaven), add 4 earth beads → heaven + 4 earth = 9! 🏆
strings.l2_lesson3_step1_body: When you SUBTRACT, push beads DOWN (away from the beam). Start at 4, subtract 2 → push 2 earth beads DOWN = 2!
strings.l2_lesson3_step2_body: Push 4 earth beads up to the beam. Your abacus shows 4! This is your starting number.
strings.l2_lesson3_step3_body: Watch! Start at 4, push 2 earth beads DOWN → 2! ✅
strings.l2_lesson3_step4_body: Watch! Start at 8 (heaven + 3 earth), push 3 earth beads DOWN → just heaven = 5! Heaven stays! 🌟
strings.l2_lesson3_step5_body: Only earth beads move — heaven bead NEVER moves in this lesson! Try: 9 − 4 = ? and 4 − 1 = ?
strings.l2_lesson4_step1_body: When you subtract 5 or more, push the heaven bead AWAY from the beam (UP = −5). Let's practice!
strings.l2_lesson4_step2_body: Watch! Heaven bead is DOWN (= 5). Push it UP → all beads away = 0! Simple heaven removal! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson4_step3_body: Watch! Start at 7 (heaven + 2 earth). Push heaven UP (−5) → just 2 earth beads = 2! Earth stays! ✅
strings.l2_lesson4_step4_body: Watch! Start at 9 (heaven + 4 earth). Push 3 earth DOWN, then push heaven UP → 1 earth = 1! 🌟
strings.l2_lesson4_step5_body: Subtract 5 → push heaven UP. Subtract more → remove earth first, then heaven. No formula needed! 🚀
strings.l2_lesson5_step1_body: Real math mixes adding AND subtracting! You already know both separately. Now let's use them together! 🚀
strings.l2_lesson5_step2_body: Watch! Start at 3, add 5 → swap to heaven + 3 earth = 8! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson5_step3_body: Watch! Start at 8, push 2 earth beads DOWN → heaven + 1 earth = 6! ✨
strings.l2_lesson5_step4_body: Watch! Start at 5 (heaven), push heaven UP and 3 earth UP → 3! 🌟
strings.l2_lesson5_step5_body: Adding pushes beads TOWARD the beam. Subtracting pushes beads AWAY from the beam. Mix them freely! 🎊 Level 2 Complete! 🏆
strings.l2_lesson6_step1_body: When adding would overflow the earth beads but result stays ≤ 9, use the Small Friend formula: remove earth beads + push heaven DOWN.
strings.l2_lesson6_step2_body: Try 1+4. Can't just add 4 earth (only 3 free!). Formula: remove 1 earth DOWN, push heaven DOWN. 1−1+5 = 5! ✨
strings.l2_lesson6_step3_body: Try 2+3. Formula: remove 2 earth DOWN, push heaven DOWN. 2−2+5 = 5! Same net result!
strings.l2_lesson6_step4_body: Try 3+4. Formula: remove 1 earth DOWN, push heaven DOWN. 3−1+5 = 7! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson6_step5_body: +1=−4+5 | +2=−3+5 | +3=−2+5 | +4=−1+5. The two numbers always add to 5! 🤝 That's the 5-complement trick!
strings.l2_lesson7_step1_body: If your number is 5, 6, 7 or 8, the heaven bead is already touching the beam! When you need to subtract but there aren't enough earth beads — push heaven UP and move earth beads UP to the beam instead! That's the Small Friend swap! 🤝
strings.l2_lesson7_step2_body: Try 5−1. Heaven is DOWN. Can't remove 1 earth! Formula: push heaven UP (−5), add 4 earth UP (+4). 5−5+4 = 4! ✅
strings.l2_lesson7_step3_body: Try 5−2. Push heaven UP (−5), add 3 earth UP (+3). 5−5+3 = 3! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson7_step4_body: Try 7−4. Heaven + 2 earth = 7. Push heaven UP (7→2), add 1 earth UP. 7−5+1 = 3! 🌟
strings.l2_lesson7_step5_body: −1=+4−5 | −2=+3−5 | −3=+2−5 | −4=+1−5. Heaven bead swaps with earth beads! The two numbers always add to 5. 🤝
strings.l2_lesson8_step1_body: When ones column is full and result goes to 10+, carry a bead to the TENS column! Formula: +N = +10 − (10−N). Watch the tens rod light up!
strings.l2_lesson8_step2_body: Try 9+1. Ones is full (heaven+4earth=9). Carry: add 1 to TENS, remove 9 from ones. 9+1=10 → tens=1, ones=0! 🎉
strings.l2_lesson8_step3_body: Try 5+6. Ones shows 5 (heaven). Carry: add 1 to TENS, remove 4 from ones. 5+6=11 → tens=1, ones=1! ✨
strings.l2_lesson8_step4_body: Try 5+9. Heaven down (=5). Carry: add 1 to TENS, take 1 from ones: heaven UP + 4 earth UP. 5+9=14 → tens=1, ones=4! 🌟
strings.l2_lesson8_step5_body: +1=−9+10, +2=−8+10 … +9=−1+10. Always: add 10 to tens, subtract the complement from ones. Pairs add to 10! 🔢
strings.l2_lesson9_step1_body: When ones column doesn't have enough beads to subtract, BORROW from the tens column! Formula: −N = −10 + (10−N).
strings.l2_lesson9_step2_body: Try 10−1. Ones is 0! Borrow: remove 1 from TENS, add 9 to ones. 10−1=9 → tens=0, ones=9! ✅
strings.l2_lesson9_step3_body: Try 10−2. Borrow: remove 1 from TENS, add 8 to ones. 10−2=8! ✨
strings.l2_lesson9_step4_body: Try 11−6. Ones has only 1 bead — can't remove 6! Borrow: −1 from TENS, +4 to ones. 11−6=5! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson9_step5_body: −1=+9−10, −2=+8−10 … −9=+1−10. Always: borrow 10 from tens, add the complement to ones. Pairs add to 10! 🔢
strings.l2_lesson10_step1_body: Sometimes you need BOTH a heaven-bead swap AND a tens carry in one step. This 'Family' formula combines Small Friend + Big Friend together!
strings.l2_lesson10_step2_body: Try 7+6. Heaven is down (7=heaven+2earth). Family: heaven UP (7→2), carry to tens, add 1 earth. 7+6=13! ✨
strings.l2_lesson10_step3_body: Try 6+9. Heaven UP (6→1), carry to tens, add 4 earth. 6+9=15! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson10_step4_body: Try 11−6. Tens=1, ones=1. Borrow from tens (−10), push heaven DOWN (+5), remove 1 earth (−1). 11−6=5! 🌟

strings.l2_group1_why: The ones rod can only hold 4 earth beads! When there's no room for more earth beads but the answer is still below 10, we do a magic swap with the heaven bead! 🪄
strings.l2_group1_when: When you want to add 1, 2, 3, or 4 — but there's no more space for earth beads!
strings.l2_group1_how: Push earth beads DOWN + push heaven bead DOWN at the same time. Two moves = one answer! 🤝
strings.l2_group2_why: When your number is 5–8, the heaven bead is already down. Need to subtract but not enough earth beads? Swap the heaven bead back and get earth beads in return! 🔄
strings.l2_group2_when: When you want to subtract 1, 2, 3, or 4 — but not enough earth beads to remove!
strings.l2_group2_how: Push heaven bead UP + add earth beads UP at the same time. Two moves = one answer! 🤝
strings.l2_group3_why: When adding makes your total 10 or bigger, you need to carry over to the TENS rod next door! Think of moving to a bigger neighborhood! 🏘️
strings.l2_group3_when: When adding would make your total 10 or more — time to carry!
strings.l2_group3_how: Add 1 bead to the TENS rod (+10), then remove beads from ONES rod. They balance out to give the right answer! 🔢
strings.l2_group4_why: When the ONES rod is empty but you still need to subtract, borrow 10 from the TENS rod next door! Like borrowing a crayon from a friend! 🖍️
strings.l2_group4_when: When the ones rod doesn't have enough beads to subtract!
strings.l2_group4_how: Remove 1 bead from TENS rod (−10), then add beads to ONES rod. Borrow and give back — easy! 🔢
strings.l2_group5_why: Sometimes adding needs BOTH a heaven swap AND a carry to tens — all at once! Small Friend and Big Friend team up as a family! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
strings.l2_group5_when: When adding 6, 7, 8, or 9 — and the heaven bead is already DOWN!
strings.l2_group5_how: 3 quick moves: heaven UP (−5) → carry to TENS (+10) → add a few earth beads. All at once! 🤝
strings.l2_group6_why: Sometimes subtracting needs both a borrow from tens AND a heaven bead — all at once! The whole family works together! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
strings.l2_group6_when: When subtracting 6, 7, 8, or 9 — and there aren't enough earth beads!
strings.l2_group6_how: 3 quick moves: borrow from TENS (−10) → heaven bead DOWN (+5) → remove a few earth beads. Team effort! 🤝
